title: The Offline Diagram Desk
pitch: Pair Magnitude's fully local model hosting with Diagram Design's 38 editorial diagram types to build an on-premise 'draw this as a diagram' tool for organizations that can't send internal data to a cloud AI: a hospital IT team mapping a patient-data workflow, a law firm charting a case timeline, or a bank's compliance team diagramming an internal process for an audit. Everything — the model, the diagram generation, the output files — stays on the buyer's own hardware, so nothing sensitive (org structure, financial flows, case details) ever leaves the building. Sell it as a locked-down desktop app or internal server appliance rather than a subscription, priced for the compliance budget rather than the marketing budget.
why_now: As more regulated industries want AI help with internal documentation and process mapping, the blocker is almost never capability — it's that cloud AI can't touch their data. Local inference just became good enough to run this kind of on-device generation, and this mashup sits exactly at that gap.
